# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `rippling` MCP server. The Remote MCP server URL is copied from Rippling → My IT → MCP connectors.
- Auth is the signed-in employee's Rippling account. There is no API token or client ID to configure.
- Logo: Rippling's mark from the Rippling GitHub organization.
